import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

NUMBER = re.compile(r"^[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$")

def score_archive(archive_path, group, out):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
        members = sorted(
            n for n in zf.namelist()
            if n.endswith(".faa.mafft") and not n.endswith("/")
        )
        if not members:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No .faa.mafft alignments in {archive_path}")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            work = Path(td)
            for index, member in enumerate(members):
                local = work / f"alignment_{index}.fa"
                local.write_bytes(zf.read(member))
                run = subprocess.run(
                    ["phykit", "rcv", str(local)],
                    text=True,
                    capture_output=True,
                    check=True,
                )
                value = run.stdout.strip()
                if not NUMBER.fullmatch(value):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        f"Unexpected PhyKIT rcv output for {member}: {value!r}; "
